messages:
leo: Quick nudge: PM flagged Action Item #9 from the postmortem (audit-export for Private VPCs) is overdue. Owner listed as tara. Can you share status and an updated ETA? cc @cthomas @amar

tara: Sorry, been heads down. The blocker was S3 IAM creds for air-gapped customers — needed an option for signed URL proxy. I have a branch but needed legal to confirm allowed telemetry fields. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pr/4598 (WIP). ETA: aiming to unblock legal today, then finish tests tomorrow. :confused:

cthomas: We need this sooner for a customer compliance audit next week. If legal clearance is the holdup, can you share the minimal fieldset proposal here so we can pressure for rapid review?

tara: Copying the proposal into the PR description now. Minimal fields: request_id, model_name, truncated_prompt_hash, timestamp (no user PII). Added example payload and masking rules.

amar: Thanks @tara. From security side that fieldset looks sane but we need the masking rule for prompt_hash in the doc. Can you add a short test in the PR that demonstrates masking? That will speed sign-off.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action Item #9 assigned to tara is overdue (due 1805413476). Please update the incident tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-094/actions.

leo: If this slips another 48h, we should escalate to legal + CISO sync. @tara can you estimate if tests + legal will finish by EOD tomorrow?

tara: With tests added and the PR updated I think legal sign-off will be a 24h turnaround. New ETA: tomorrow 5pm PT. I added a minimal unit test `tests/test_masking.py` to the branch.

cthomas: Can you paste the masking test snippet here for quick eyeballs?

tara: Sure:
```python
def test_mask_prompt_hash_masking():
    payload = make_audit_payload(raw_prompt="sensitive stuff")
    assert "sensitive" not in payload["prompt_hash"]
    assert len(payload["prompt_hash"]) == 64
```

amar: That looks good. I'll queue security review now.

leo: Copy. Scheduling a 15m triage in case legal has follow-ups: 1805511600 (tomorrow 10:00 PT) if still pending.

[tomorrow at 10:05 PT]
ops-bot: Deployment pipeline report: PR 4598 build passed, canary failed on one smoke in private-staging (timeout on upload proxy).

tara: Investigating the timeout — looks like proxy URI needs retry/backoff when the signed URL is slow. Pushed fix for backoff. Re-running canary.

cthomas: Legal approved payload and masking, security approved masking test. Good to go once canary green.

ops-bot: Canary in private-staging passed at 1805513276.

leo: Great. @tara once you merge, please update the incident tracker and leave a short note in the postmortem about adding "signed-url backoff" to recurring issues.

tara: Merged PR, updated tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-094/actions#9. Postmortem updated with recurrence note. Closing Action Item #9. :white_check_mark:

amar: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short blameless note to legal about expected turnaround for telemetry approvals.

leo: Closing thread. Good catch and quick follow-through. :clap:
